term: necessary existing individual under the original Scenario concrete predicate
definition: Some SAME rigid individual satisfies the supplied Scenario concrete predicate, exists at the selected world, and exists at every accessible world. The original concrete predicate is world-independent. This asserts no causal capability beyond that supplied interpretation, uniqueness, sourcehood, intrinsic explanatory adequacy or divine attribute.
note: Exact existing Scenario.NecessaryConcreteAt endpoint. The existing BruteFoundationBoundary.NecessaryConcreteAt uses a different profile type and is not silently substituted. concrete is a supplied B→Prop; no identification with causal capability, physicality, existential independence or modal causal activity is made. A separate registered logical projection retains the same Ontic and same witness while dropping only its concreteness conjunct.
